brief:
A group of Democratic representatives has introduced legislation to impose sanctions on expanding Israeli settlements in the West Bank and Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. The bill reflects growing pressure within the party against settlement expansion, which is considered illegal under international law.

The move signals an escalation in Democratic efforts to hold Israel accountable for settlement activity, marking a shift in congressional approach to the issue.
dek: US representatives introduce bill sanctioning expanding Israeli settlements A growing number of Democratic lawmakers are ramping up pressure on Israel, introducing legislation to impose sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank and Gaza.
title: US Democrats introduce bill to sanction Israeli settlements
